explanation: Binary-search a bracket containing the root, using [x,1] below one and [1,x] above one. Move the endpoint according to the squared midpoint and stop when the bracket is equal within the relative floating-point comparison.
timeComplexity: O(log(B/ε)) bisection iterations for initial bracket width B and achieved resolution ε.
